title: The Library Underwater

breakdown.title: The Library Underwater

words: i was in the old city library, the big reading room. green glass lamps on every desk, shelves up to the ceiling. totally quiet.
yeah, and then water actually started coming in under the doors. kept rising till books floated off the shelves, hundreds of them, open like birds.
it was weirdly okay, just watching them. my older sister showed up in a little yellow rowing boat, calm, told me to get in.
she rowed us between the shelves. then a whale swam past under us, so big it filled the whole aisle. wasn't scared at all.
we rowed up to the high round window at the top of the room. she opened it, and outside it was morning. whole city underwater, just rooftops and tops of trees.
yeah. then i woke up.
peaceful, mostly. like everything was just still and gone, but not in a bad way.
yeah. i think about that part a lot.
that moment, and being in the boat with her. felt safe.
she was just calm the whole time, like this was normal for her. like she already knew the way out.
yeah. she didn't say much, just rowed. but it was enough.
mostly ahead. i don't really remember her face that clearly. just her being calm.
right. i knew it was her the same way you just know things in dreams.
yeah, the way the whole city looked in the morning light. i didn't want to stop seeing it.
it has stayed with me.

that's right. the only thing i'd add is it was a whale under the water, and the water was already high, over the desks and up between the shelves. and she opened the window at the top. but yeah, you got it.
